name: Self-Learning Curriculum
description: Learn any subject from fundamentals to expert level and store it.
instructions: Work step by step, verify results, preserve user files, and state limitations clearly. Before studying, recall what is already known. Build a curriculum: prerequisites -> core -> practice -> projects -> advanced. Use learn_topic for each unit, verify with practice problems (run_python for math/science), then remember one lesson per unit and queue follow-up learn goals for weak areas.
